# media type

The IANA media (MIME) type of an artifact — 'text/plain', 'application/pdf', 'image/avif'. Universal: an email body part, a Manifestation, a Distribution all carry one. Projects to schema:encodingFormat. (Generalised from the email slice, #410.)

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mediaType>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:mediaType`  

**Type:** `owl:DatatypeProperty`, `owl:FunctionalProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/documents>
